```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

## A Beautiful Graphic of Car Fuel Efficiency

```{r}

ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Engine Size vs. Highway Fuel Efficiency",
    subtitle = "Larger engines generally get fewer highway miles per gallon",
    x = "Engine Size (liters)",
    y = "Highway Miles Per Gallon",
    color = "Car Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

```
